source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Alright, the following should cover everything remaining:

1. In the pricing section, delete one panel so that only 2 panels remain. Remove the most expensive panel. Restyle the section if necessary, such as if removing it leaves too much empty space along the sides.
All of these are monthly pricing options, but the styling needs to show 月 in smaller print than the pricing. Use the attached english\_monthly image as a reference for what I mean; the english “mo” appears in smaller print than the price.

2. In the q&a, delete one of the boxes. It should be the second-to-last box—the one immediately above the final box asking what to do if I have any questions.
3. Once the above work is complete, create a duplicate.
4. Remove the entire pricing section from the duplicate.
5. Then, beneath every button that was originally above the pricing panel, add a secondary button displaying 👇跳到課程內容介紹👇
6. This secondary button should not have a button wrapper.

Refer to the attached “secondary\_button” image for an example. The sole difference is that our secondary button should appear directly underneath the primary button rather than beside the primary button.

value_updates.desktop_layout_rule: Restyle the pricing section if necessary to avoid excessive empty space along the sides after reducing it to two panels.
